meta.title: One Shot
meta.description: Having a trump card means that even if you're forced to play it, you can still achieve a decisive victory!

units.rawText: A mighty explosion follows the blinding flash and thunderous roar. My head is filled with a ringing noise, and I don't know how much time passes before it finally quiets down.
units.displayText: A mighty explosion follows the blinding flash and thunderous roar. My head is filled with a ringing noise, and I don't know how much time passes before it finally quiets down.

spans.text: A mighty explosion follows the blinding flash and thunderous roar. My head is filled with a ringing noise, and I don't know how much time passes before it finally quiets down.

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily)
units.displayText: Coughs heavily

spans.text: Coughs heavily

units.rawText: Guys... are you okay... I think something's wrong with my visual modules...
units.displayText: Guys... are you okay... I think something's wrong with my visual modules...

spans.text: Guys... are you okay... I think something's wrong with my visual modules...

units.rawText: Me too...
units.displayText: Me too...

spans.text: Me too...

units.rawText: Everyone, don't panic! It'll be better in a few seconds!
units.displayText: Everyone, don't panic! It'll be better in a few seconds!

spans.text: Everyone, don't panic! It'll be better in a few seconds!

units.rawText: Do as Hannah says.
units.displayText: Do as Hannah says.

spans.text: Do as Hannah says.

units.rawText: Although I shut my eyes in time, my eyeballs still ache, as though they've been set on fire.
units.displayText: Although I shut my eyes in time, my eyeballs still ache, as though they've been set on fire.

spans.text: Although I shut my eyes in time, my eyeballs still ache, as though they've been set on fire.

units.rawText: Several seconds later, the light recedes, and the surrounding terrain once again comes into view.
units.displayText: Several seconds later, the light recedes, and the surrounding terrain once again comes into view.

spans.text: Several seconds later, the light recedes, and the surrounding terrain once again comes into view.

units.rawText: ...What?
units.displayText: ...What?

spans.text: ...What?

units.rawText: The Null Area that was crawling with Entropics just a few seconds ago has now returned to its expansive blankness. Not even the Liquid Entropy remains.
units.displayText: The Null Area that was crawling with Entropics just a few seconds ago has now returned to its expansive blankness. Not even the Liquid Entropy remains.

spans.text: The Null Area that was crawling with Entropics just a few seconds ago has now returned to its expansive blankness. Not even the Liquid Entropy remains.

units.rawText: There is a long straight path that has been blasted clean of Entropics, and the Entropics slightly further away from it are twitching weakly on the ground as they slowly melt into Liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: There is a long straight path that has been blasted clean of Entropics, and the Entropics slightly further away from it are twitching weakly on the ground as they slowly melt into Liquid Entropy.

spans.text: There is a long straight path that has been blasted clean of Entropics, and the Entropics slightly further away from it are twitching weakly on the ground as they slowly melt into Liquid Entropy.

units.rawText: Wait... so this was "one shot"?
units.displayText: Wait... so this was "one shot"?

spans.text: Wait... so this was "one shot"?

units.rawText: 10% of one, to be precise.
units.displayText: 10% of one, to be precise.

spans.text: 10% of one, to be precise.

units.rawText: That's so awesome...
units.displayText: That's so awesome...

spans.text: That's so awesome...

units.rawText: Sol tugs on my hand in excitement and Croque looks into the distance in admiration.
units.displayText: Sol tugs on my hand in excitement and Croque looks into the distance in admiration.

spans.text: Sol tugs on my hand in excitement and Croque looks into the distance in admiration.

units.rawText: I imported the Cyclopes Sector's military technology, added our compressed operands to it, and heavily modified the design before eventually creating this weapon that is unique in Magrasea.
units.displayText: I imported the Cyclopes Sector's military technology, added our compressed operands to it, and heavily modified the design before eventually creating this weapon that is unique in Magrasea.

spans.text: I imported the Cyclopes Sector's military technology, added our compressed operands to it, and heavily modified the design before eventually creating this weapon that is unique in Magrasea.

units.rawText: How is it? Does it meet your expectations?
units.displayText: How is it? Does it meet your expectations?

spans.text: How is it? Does it meet your expectations?

options.rawText: You really are a genius, Hannah.
options.displayText: You really are a genius, Hannah.

spans.text: You really are a genius, Hannah.

options.rawText: This fighting strength is no less than that of a battle-type agent.
options.displayText: This fighting strength is no less than that of a battle-type agent.

spans.text: This fighting strength is no less than that of a battle-type agent.

units.rawText: Heh... Thanks for your praise, Professor.
units.displayText: Heh... Thanks for your praise, Professor.

spans.text: Heh... Thanks for your praise, Professor.

units.rawText: ...I was hoping you'd praise my intelligence.
units.displayText: ...I was hoping you'd praise my intelligence.

spans.text: ...I was hoping you'd praise my intelligence.

units.rawText: Hehe, well, with a guarantee like this, I'm sure the Oasis and Rossum's relationship will be more stable.
units.displayText: Hehe, well, with a guarantee like this, I'm sure the Oasis and Rossum's relationship will be more stable.

spans.text: Hehe, well, with a guarantee like this, I'm sure the Oasis and Rossum's relationship will be more stable.

units.rawText: Wow, what a pretentious way of phrasing it.
units.displayText: Wow, what a pretentious way of phrasing it.

spans.text: Wow, what a pretentious way of phrasing it.

units.rawText: Antonina snorts in derision as she checks the status of our casualties.
units.displayText: Antonina snorts in derision as she checks the status of our casualties.

spans.text: Antonina snorts in derision as she checks the status of our casualties.

units.rawText: Confidence without a basis is hardly confidence. I simply feel that this will make our cooperation more successful... and not look like a gamble.
units.displayText: Confidence without a basis is hardly confidence. I simply feel that this will make our cooperation more successful... and not look like a gamble.

spans.text: Confidence without a basis is hardly confidence. I simply feel that this will make our cooperation more successful... and not look like a gamble.

units.rawText: Still, it's true that I didn't expect it to be this powerful.
units.displayText: Still, it's true that I didn't expect it to be this powerful.

spans.text: Still, it's true that I didn't expect it to be this powerful.

units.rawText: I simply did my duty as Sector Administrator.
units.displayText: I simply did my duty as Sector Administrator.

spans.text: I simply did my duty as Sector Administrator.

units.rawText: It's good that you've learned to be a smooth talker, but don't be like our Professor and let your mouth get the rest of you into trouble.
units.displayText: It's good that you've learned to be a smooth talker, but don't be like our Professor and let your mouth get the rest of you into trouble.

spans.text: It's good that you've learned to be a smooth talker, but don't be like our Professor and let your mouth get the rest of you into trouble.

units.rawText: Well, as the Professor said, we had no other choice. After that shot, the railgun is well and truly out of power.
units.displayText: Well, as the Professor said, we had no other choice. After that shot, the railgun is well and truly out of power.

spans.text: Well, as the Professor said, we had no other choice. After that shot, the railgun is well and truly out of power.

units.rawText: We've lost most of our fighting strength, and although the barriers around the Admin Center can hold off these Entropics, it's only a matter of time before they break through.
units.displayText: We've lost most of our fighting strength, and although the barriers around the Admin Center can hold off these Entropics, it's only a matter of time before they break through.

units.rawText: Please support us as soon as you can, Professor.
units.displayText: Please support us as soon as you can, Professor.

spans.text: Please support us as soon as you can, Professor.

units.rawText: No problem. That one shot has put me completely at ease.
units.displayText: No problem. That one shot has put me completely at ease.

units.rawText: Yup, yup. Looks like once the Oasis' operands arrive, that cannon is going to blow everything to hell in one shot!
